747040101.text: Hey, Columbina! Are you admiring the fish in our aquarium?

747040102.text: Mmhmm. You've done an amazing job with this place. There are so many fish I've never even seen before.

747040103.text: Have you been to an aquarium before?

747040104.text: No, though I saw a few fish tanks in Snezhnaya. But my eyes weren't truly open back then, so I never really appreciated things properly.

747040106.text: It's beautiful. I never knew the underwater world was so vibrant and colorful. It's like... living in eternal springtime.

747040107.text: Oh, look at that fish. Don't you think it looks just like Sandrone? And those two over there, one following behind the other... They're like the two of you!

747040108.text: Hey, you're right! Now that you mention it, they really do look like us.

747040109.text: That busy-looking one over there reminds me of Lauma. And that one in the coral seems to be quietly observing everything, just like Lady Nefer.

747040110.text: Uhm... Paimon gets the feeling you like matching all your friends to fish...

747040111.text: Not exactly. I like my friends, so I naturally find myself thinking about them. Even when I'm looking at fish.

747040112.text: Wow! Paimon's really happy to hear you say that! So, are there any other fish that remind you of someone?

747040113.text: Hmm... I've made a lot of new friends lately. I'm afraid I can't find a fish to match every single one of them.

747040114.text: That makes sense. Anyway, we'll keep adding more fishies to the aquarium! You should come back from time to time — maybe you'll be able to find even more of your friends next time you're here!

747040115.text: ...You're going to put my friends in the aquarium?

747040116.text: Of course not! Paimon's talking about fishie lookalike friends, you big silly!
